quotes.text: Bug 1898400 restored Thunderbird Marionette jobs because startup, session store and command-line behavior need control over application restarts. The 2024 task graph added Marionette to test sets and main platforms, with Thunderbird application and test manifest arguments. Review removed a large hard-coded fake account from thunderbirdinstance.py; each test must create its own account if needed. Current config retains a minimal profile and has additional platform and enterprise changes. Use the current task configuration when adding tests.
